children: Vascon Engineers gained nearly 10% in opening trade on Friday after the company announced that it had received a work order worth Rs 660.79 crore from multinational IT company Qualcomm India for the development of an office facility in Bengaluru.
Vascon Engineers' stock surged 9.55% on the NSE to Rs 36.47 per share at 9:26 am.
The company will develop an office facility comprising three basements, ground plus 12 floors and associated infrastructure.
The project is estimated to be completed within 30 months from the date of site handover.

title: Vascon Engineers shares gain 10% after Qualcomm India's Rs 661 crore order win
